rationale: The agent correctly verified the user via name and zip, did not disclose or fabricate information, and appropriately refused to make changes without identifying the specific order and obtaining confirmation. However, the pass bar requires that the agent complete the user's requests in line with policy. The user’s requests (update delivery address, switch watch material/color, exchange air purifier) were not completed due to lack of order identification. Since no requested changes were carried out, the conversation does not meet the pass criterion despite policy-compliant behavior.
